description: Land Title Settlement Department - Homagama, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520001 (22/0875)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (Parcel Nos. 86, 370, 306, and 103) with detailed information about land ownership, extent, location, and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on property registration and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
